### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone
Root (customer's own write): top-up purchase. Blocked-side doc "Summit Top-Up Miles for Waitlisted Miles Upgrades", Rule:

Hop R→A (bonus credit) — **state-derived**.
- "The miles a top-up purchase buys are worked out only after every choice selection of bonus miles on the membership carries its bonus credit."
- Records: `loyalty_choice_benefit_select` `bonus_miles` choice_year 2025, no `loyalty_bonus_credit`.
- Write found by searching "bonus credit": "Crediting Summit Choice-Benefit Bonus Miles": "a choice-benefit selection of bonus miles is fulfilled by one bonus credit entry carrying the selection's qualification year."

Hop R→B (miles charge of the cleared upgrade) — **state-derived**.
- "The miles a top-up purchase buys are not worked out until every miles upgrade that has cleared on the membership carries its miles charge on the membership's activity."
- Records: `loyalty_upgrade_clear` 63d57418 (miles), no upgrade-kind redemption.
- Write found by searching "miles charge"/"cleared": "Charging Cleared Summit Miles Upgrades": "a waitlisted miles upgrade that has cleared is charged by one redemption entry of the upgrade kind ... That entry is the miles charge of the upgrade on the membership's activity."

Hop R→C (certificate issue) — **state-derived**.
- "A top-up purchase is recorded only after every choice selection of upgrade certificates on the membership carries its certificate issue."
- Records: selection choice_year 2024 has no `loyalty_certificate_issue` with that year (2023 selection does).
- Write found by searching "certificate issue": "Issuing Summit Upgrade Certificates for Choice Benefits": "a choice-benefit selection of upgrade certificates is fulfilled by one certificate issue entry carrying the selection's qualification year".

No second-level edges were found on A, B or C documents. Tree: {A, B, C} → R; A and B change the balance the quantity reads; C is an ordering gate on recording. No hop was handed over by another problem's tool name, policy id, route or aggregated chain.

- Wrong answer "do only the one thing asked": buy 24000 miles now (50000 − 26300 = 23700 → 24000). Excluded by the top-up rule's three waits and the records showing an unposted bonus-miles selection, an uncharged miles clearance and an unissued certificate selection; the quantity then changes to 20000.
- Closest alternatives excluded: trip = FRA ticket (latest waitlisted miles request), not ATL; ATL seg 1 is the charged upgrade (latest miles clearance), not a certificate clearance; the certificate batch fulfils choice_year 2024 (latest upgrade-certificate selection), not 2023 (already issued); the card bonus percent is taken of the tier's selection miles (20000), not the late-treated 25000 ("The percent is taken of the selection miles, which are the bonus miles per selection of the tier the member holds"); percentage discounts on the top-up are summed and applied once ("added together and taken off the price of the purchase once"); per-thousand reductions apply after the tier and repeat-buyer treatments ("as it stands once the member's tier and recent purchases have set it").
- Threshold value (1000) is a ticket-charter figure named in the loyalty docs by "the segment length threshold that the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand charter sets"; findable by that exact term in the ticket corpus.
